page.overview:
Who is Assistant 2?

Assistant 2 is a man who is hired along with Assistant 1 to help Homer Simpson when his hands are stuck in two vending machines. Originally they were going to saw his arms off, but they refrained when they learned he was only stuck because he refused to let go of the products inside.
